title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Tennessee)
authority: Tennessee employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Tennessee requires employers with 35 or more employees to use E-Verify; sources also give 50 or more, with smaller employers allowed to use E-Verify or collect identity documents.

appliesWhen.description: 35 or more employees in the state

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: First knowing violation: a $500 company penalty plus $500 for each unverified employee; repeat violations up to $2,500 plus $2,500 per employee (state Department of Labor page).
